entities.name: Saheena
entities.description: A resilient Vulshok woman of Neyali's Mirran Resistance cell on New Phyrexia, who lost an eye in a skirmish.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: Resistance against the Phyrexians, including Neyali's cell.
